artifact: GLM-5.2 read-only NVMe characterization fio-worker exclusivity attempt
failure: fio forked its own worker outside the launcher process group; the exclusivity monitor classified that exact worker as an unrelated fio process and terminated the cell fail-closed
resolution: Allow only a fio process whose complete argv is byte-for-byte equal to the frozen launched command. Any other fio, model engine, evidence process, or accelerator user remains a conflict.
